# Battery Cooling System Design Review - 2026-09-15

## Attendees
- Michael Chen, Design Lead
- Sarah Johnson, Safety Engineer
- James Wilson, Engineering Manager
- Alex Rodriguez, Thermal Systems
- Taylor Kim, Manufacturing

## Purpose
Review final design for battery cooling system in Gravity SUV.

## Proposed Design
- Simplified cooling channel layout
- Reduced number of thermal sensors (from 12 to 8)
- Use of lower-cost coolant material
- Elimination of redundant cooling loops

## Benefits
- 22% reduction in manufacturing costs ($450 savings per unit)
- 15% reduction in assembly time
- Weight reduction of 3.2kg
- Improved thermal efficiency under normal operating conditions (25°C-35°C ambient)

## Safety Assessment
Sarah Johnson presented thermal modeling results showing:
- Under extreme conditions (45°C+ ambient, 90%+ state of charge, aggressive driving), thermal runaway risk increases from 1 in 20,000 units to 1 in 5,000 units
- Recommended mitigation: Add thermal barriers between cells and implement enhanced monitoring system
- Mitigation cost: $450 per unit, 8-week production delay

## Decision
After discussion, team decided to proceed with cost-optimized design. Safety features will be evaluated for future iterations. Field performance will be monitored closely.

## Action Items
- Michael: Update final design documentation
- Taylor: Adjust manufacturing workflow
- Alex: Prepare thermal performance report for leadership
- Sarah: Document risk assessment in safety file

# Battery System Design v3

## Cooling System Specifications

### Design Overview
Cost-optimized cooling system for Gravity SUV battery pack. Focus on manufacturing efficiency and cost reduction.

### Components
- Single-loop cooling channel (replaces dual-loop design)
- 8 thermal sensors (reduced from 12)
- Standard-grade coolant (replaces high-temperature formulation)
- Simplified manifold design

### Performance Metrics
- Weight: 18.7kg (2.3kg reduction from v2)
- Manufacturing cost: $2,100 per unit (22% reduction)
- Assembly time: 45 minutes (15% reduction)

### Thermal Performance
- Normal conditions (25-35°C): 92% efficiency
- High load conditions: 78% efficiency
- Maximum operating temperature: 45°C

### Safety Features
- Standard thermal cutoff
- Pressure relief valves
- Basic monitoring system

*Note: Advanced safety features (thermal barriers, enhanced monitoring) were evaluated but not included in this version due to cost constraints.*
